decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan: (08)01. Drawings: A2-SD3070, (72)14, Noise Impact Assessment up to 23.00 page 1-3, Noise Impact Assessment after 23.00 page 1-3. Received: 09/09/2016; Additional Documents: GigaBox centrifugal fan, IV Produkt dimensions sheet, M011, Air Conditioning Product Information, Schedule of Outdoor Units, (02)03, Slimshield Louvres product datasheet, Slimshield Louvre Certified Dimension Sheet (Form No. 104/0). Received: 31/01/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - a) Before any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers is used at the premises, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which demonstrates that the following noise design requirements can be complied with and shall thereafter be retained as approved.
b) The cumulative measured rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall achieve a rating level (in accordance with BS4142:2014) of 36dB LAeq,T at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises and at 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.  Tonal/impulsive noise frequencies should be eliminated or at least considered in any assessment and should carry an additional correction in accordance with BS4142:2014.
	c) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter
	d) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted within 4 months of the date of this permission for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. Condition : 4 - The acoustic screening hereby approved shall be installed within three months of the date of this permission and shall thereafter be maintained as such.
description: Retrospective Application for installation of air conditioning units at rear of property and installation of acoustic screen
